ideas.pitch: A real-time defense-in-depth API gateway intercepting LLM traffic to block novel prompt injections, indirect RAG poison payloads, and recursive jailbreaks using semantic guardrails.
ideas.title: JailbreakGuard LLM Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core cybersecurity challenge of securing the AI-powered enterprise by showcasing defense-in-depth architecture and zero-trust LLM middleware.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise firewall and behavioral analysis proxy that inspects natural language prompts and generated SQL queries to prevent LLM-driven SQL injection attacks and schema exfiltration.
ideas.title: SQLi-Sentinel for NL2SQL
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on NL2SQL Injection, a high-severity enterprise AI risk area specifically highlighted in the challenge guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A runtime privilege escalation monitor for autonomous agent loops that flags unauthorized tool execution, unauthorized API calls, and lateral movement attempts across microservice boundaries.
ideas.title: AgenticPrivGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Agentic AI Privilege Escalation, tapping into cutting-edge runtime security research valued by red-teamers and enterprise security judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated pipeline scanner that detects and neutralizes data poisoning payloads hidden inside documents before vector database ingestion and retrieval-augmented generation queries run.
ideas.title: RAG-Sanitizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves RAG Poisoning vulnerabilities through rigorous data pipeline inspection, aligning with the red-teaming focus of the evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: An automated reconnaissance tool that scans enterprise open-source intelligence exposure, mapping leaked API keys, hardcoded prompt instructions, and exposed internal model endpoints.
ideas.title: AI-OSINT Footprint Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Covers AI OSINT and AI Supply Chain Security tracks, providing an offensive security tool that penetration testers and bug-bounty hunters can immediately put into practice.
